description: Defines the MotionDetection class for a plugin handling motion detection via JSONRPC in the WPEFramework. Includes method declarations for controlling and querying motion detection features, and event handling.

classes.name: MotionDetection
classes.description: A plugin class for motion detection, supporting JSONRPC communication, with methods for controlling motion detectors and handling motion events.

methods.name: getMotionDetectors
methods.description: Retrieves information about available motion detectors.

methods.name: isarmed
methods.description: Checks if motion detection is armed.

methods.name: setNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period with no motion detection.

methods.name: getNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current no-motion period setting.

methods.name: setSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity level for motion detection.

methods.name: getLastMotionEventElapsedTime
methods.description: Gets the elapsed time since the last motion event.

methods.name: setMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Sets the active period for motion events.

methods.name: getMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the active period for motion events.
